statement: Board.cs specifies a 100 by 100 grid, randomized initial occupancy using rand.Next(10000) % 10 == 0, and six ordered passes per season: refresh, organism setup, action choice, effects and births, dead-organism removal, then movement. Board age is integer season count divided by 8. BoardSquare begins with 3 food, caps it at 10 and replenishes 1 every 8 refreshes; neighbor lookup has finite boundaries rather than wraparound.
uncertainty: Constants and control flow verified statically. Approximately 10% occupancy is an intended predicate probability, not a measured initial population; shared parallel random access prevents a stronger distribution claim.

statement: Organisms have eight DNA elements chosen from Eat, Move, GenerateFood, Kill, CombineDna, Evolve, Heal and Infect. Parent recombination alternates positions or takes two halves, with a per-element random replacement predicate. The action classes queue food, health, movement, age, mutation and birth effects. Evolve mutates, while Infect queues mutation in a target. Source names are simulation terminology, not evidence of biological validity.
uncertainty: Source observations establish inspected text and structure, not runtime behavior or an accepted experiment design.

statement: Action selection includes individual learned scores, not just sequential playback of the genome. StrategyNetwork stores accumulated scores by target DnaCode and action index, chooses its highest known score unless all known scores are negative, and otherwise chooses a random DNA element. OrganismEvaluation supplies fixed weights involving food, health, age and offspring; these are internal heuristics, not User's experiment success criteria.
uncertainty: Source observations establish inspected text and structure, not runtime behavior or an accepted experiment design.

statement: The declared mutation limit is 2, but MutateMe uses byte remainingChange and a remainingChange >= 0 loop guard. statement: The untouched tracked source baseline at local Git commit 1637a5dd7af2a469904cba9e3ce8789faa68467a rebuilt successfully with VS2022 MSBuild and SDK9.0.315 before the R01 mechanics edits. Six desired-behavior regressions then failed against original mechanics/renderer: mutation cap, parental history, zero-baseline arithmetic, stale target, origin selection and byte overflow. A four-season unseeded production smoke completed with populations 917,890,879,873. This is the recorded original baseline, separate from successor reference runs.
uncertainty: One short unseeded smoke is not a survival/performance distribution or a comparable reference baseline. The test harness was additive and separately identified.

statement: R01 implementation is complete: mutation selects at most two distinct unprotected positions; matching parent scores transfer independently with two-parent averaging; zero-baseline changes remain finite and empty targets clear old snapshots; food addition saturates; cells are picked safely; all-Eat patterns remain visible. New explicit reference/reset/snapshot support enables bounded comparisons. The viewer has a passive 256-season history, accurate labels and post-movement statistics, and waits for worker completion before reset/close. A longer-test null-snapshot crash exposed stale learning evaluation on aging ticks; a failing regression preceded the repair to evaluate only newly executed actions. Production parallel rules remain, while initialization/random access and removal of forced collection are explicit interventions.
uncertainty: These are authorized implementation choices, not proof of biological realism or improved fun. Reference scheduling, RNG and effect order differ from original production. Ninth-tick aging, double reproduction counter and separate target/action selection remain characterized, not redesigned.

statement: Final VS2022 x64 MSBuild rebuilt all five solution projects in Debug/Any CPU and Release/Mixed Platforms using SDK9.0.315. Both builds have zero errors and 163 CA1416 warnings. The full Release run covered fixed scenarios within the provisional 60-second overall target. No dependencies were installed/downloaded; no missing-DLL blocker occurred. The whole .sln and existing App x64/target frameworks remain; global.json selects .NET9.0.3xx. Current source/assembly hashes and results are recorded.
